sections.heading: Program Description
sections.heading_path: Executive Coaching and Organizational Consulting (MS) > Program Description
sections.text: The MS in Executive Coaching and Organizational Consulting is designed to address the growing demand for highly skilled and academically trained executive coaching and organizational consulting professionals. Students will be prepared to enhance individual and organizational effectiveness through coaching leaders on goal-setting, presence, performance, and effective communication as well as consulting with leaders on organizational culture, systems and design. Throughout the program, we integrate the concepts and competencies of coaching and consulting to enhance our overall effectiveness to help organizations thrive. Leading academics and industry practitioners will bridge evidence-based science and applied practice to empower students to become more influential and strategic executive coaches and organizational consultants.

sections.heading: Admissions
sections.heading_path: Executive Coaching and Organizational Consulting (MS) > Admissions
sections.text: Admission to master’s programs at the NYU School of Professional Studies requires the completion of a U.S. bachelor's degree or its international equivalent. Admissions decisions are made through a holistic review process. Visit the SPS Admissions website for detailed application requirements and deadlines.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.heading_path: Executive Coaching and Organizational Consulting (MS) > Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
Upon successful completion of the program, graduates will:

- Apply the foundations of behavioral sciences underlying coaching and consulting practices.
- Employ solution-focused coaching and consulting approaches in working with individuals, teams, and organizations.
- Assess the efficacy and measure the impact of coaching and consulting solutions for individuals, teams, and organizations.
- Develop and apply the industry recommended core coaching competencies in an organizational setting.
- Utilize leading consulting frameworks in developing customized consulting approaches.
- Adapt a broad spectrum of coaching and consulting tools and techniques to effectively conduct a client engagement.
- Analyze client needs to adopt a client-centric approach to coaching and consulting engagements.
- Manage all stages of coaching and consulting projects to optimize individual, team, and organizational performance within diverse practice areas.
- Incorporate highest professional standards and codes of ethics to support coaching and consulting engagements.
- Practice inclusion and keep bias out of coaching and consulting client interactions.
